reviews.text:
Our dog had a great time
We received information and photos every day

I am very satisfied with the cat boarding house! Kind, caring and reliable people took care of my cat. I constantly received pictures and feedback, so I could rest assured while I was away. My cat came home balanced and cheerful, which says everything about the care. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a loving and safe place for their pet!

This is the second time we have entrusted our dogs to the owners, and we are extremely satisfied! My female dogs were housed in a beautiful environment, in a very clean and tidy kennel. I recommend them to everyone! They are kind and professional! 🥰🩷☺️

I visited 7 pensions in Budapest and my experience is that the comments often do not reflect reality!! In most pensions, dogs are kept in packs, I don't understand why they don't have a separate place?! I noticed that many pensions do not take care of cooling the dogs at all in this hot weather. To my great joy, I found the Airport Cat and Dog Pension! From the first moment, the sophisticated environment made a very good impression and the lady welcomed us very kindly. In the hot weather, everything was watered, so there was very good air in the yard and in the kennels. The pension is beautiful, located in a green area! My dog ​​got a covered, 20 square meter, cool, clean kennel. The dog run was also nicely arranged, grassed (the dogs don't play in the dust, they run around). When I went to pick it up, my dog ​​behaved completely as if he had not been far from me. Once again, I would like to thank the lady for her care and correct attitude! What is even better is that during my vacation, the lady informed me about the condition of my dog ​​at my request! I recommend them with a clear heart, even to demanding owners!

Our dog Léna felt very good, she hardly wanted to come home.
Thank you very much

We traveled for 1 week and I was looking for a place to take care of my cat until then. It was the best choice, I recommend them to everyone! :) It was as if I hadn't even left, they really paid attention to my little elf🩷🐈 …
Our 10-month-old puppy felt great for a week. We received him back in perfect condition, both physically and mentally!
Our cat felt very comfortable in a large and pleasant room, in a real family environment.🥰 …

My cat Cukorka was at the guesthouse for two weeks. Ági is a miracle! She is a true animal lover, kind and devoted.❤️ I brought her home today clean and well-groomed. She was cute, calm and cuddly, as if she had not been away. From this we can only conclude that she was treated well, competently and with love. My velvet paw will be a returning guest.🥰
I recommend them with all my heart!!! ❤️❤️

My cats (Falko, Szőrmók and Lilu) and I have been guests at the Airport Dog and Cat Boarding House several times. They spent their days in a tidy, clean environment, in a cat room and not in a cage. Their flexibility and kindness helped a lot. Thank you for taking care of the cats. I recommend the opportunity to other cat owners.

Kind, helpful, experienced couple.
They have a separate room for the cats, they are not kept in a kennel, they do not meet other cats or other animals, which is a huge advantage.
We highly recommend them.

We have had a particularly good experience with the Airport Dog and Cat Boarding House. You have to walk 70-80 meters from the main road to the green belt ranch created in the forest.
The place is also spectacular. We bring our dog and cat here several times every year. The kennels are spacious, clean, well-covered and safe. The room is also sophisticated, spotlessly clean, air-conditioned. We heartily recommend this place to owners who want their little pets to be completely safe in a familiar, sophisticated place!
I recommend this great little place to everyone. 😊🤎 …
We have been bringing our dog here for a long time, and he loves it there. I recommend it to everyone! 🙂 …

This is the first time we visited the guesthouse with our dog, Bodza. He enjoyed their hospitality for 5 days. The design of the place is absolutely tailored to the needs of the guests. I highly recommend this guesthouse.
Great place, attentive care, clean environment – ​​I will bring my favorite here next time!
They were very kind and caring, my dog/cat felt safe. I highly recommend it!
A very good pet friendly place, our dog and cat felt very comfortable.
Our two puppies were at the guesthouse for two weeks, everything was fine, they couldn't bear the absence. The owners are very kind and polite. Thank you for taking care of our puppies!

Excellent, pet-friendly place!
We took our dog Málna to the guesthouse for 1 week. Everything is designed for the "guests". Clean, spacious beds, environment.
The owners do everything for a problem-free service. They satisfy all needs, you can discuss everything with them. During our stay there, when we asked, they informed us by phone about our dog's condition.
Our dog had been to another guesthouse, but after that he was not himself for a week. Now it was as if he had not left, he came home in the same good mood. I can only recommend the guesthouse, we will definitely come back!
Thank you! 😉🐕

We bring our dogs here every year. They love the place, they get along well. This way the family can also have a peaceful vacation. Thanks to the owner, who treats the animals as his own. I recommend it to others, because he is very kind to everyone.

We would like to thank you for the competent and loving care! Sokni, our dachshund, always goes with great pleasure and returns home happy and satisfied from this sophisticated, clean, family-friendly guesthouse. We recommend it with a calm heart to those owners who value a calm environment and loving care!
Thank you for looking after our cat Boris 😊 …

We have been taking our fox to this dog boarding house for 5 years now, and every time it is confirmed that we could not have chosen a better place. The owner is incredibly kind, attentive and truly loves animals – it is not just a job for them, it is a profession.

Our dog always goes in happily, and when we bring him home, it is clear that he had a good time, played a lot and was loved. We are especially pleased that they also handle fox's temperament well – they know how to tire him out, how to play with him, and always pay attention to his individual needs.

The boarding house is clean and tidy. We leave our dog there with complete peace of mind, because we know that he is in the best hands.

I recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone who wants their dog to receive not just supervision, but real care!
We just brought the two perpetual motion machines, they were here for the first time this year and at first glance they really enjoyed it. Thank you and we recommend them!!!
We have been to the dog boarding house again and thank you very much for the professional care once again.
We have been taking Picúr to them for years. They are always very kind and helpful. And they take loving care of the kitten.
We took our cat to the boarding house for the second time. They are very kind and love animals. They take great care of the animals in a very beautiful environment. I can only recommend them.
Thank you very much ;)

We have been regularly bringing our four cats here on trips for a few years now. The place is extremely spacious, friendly, the lady who takes care of it is kind, and the cats quickly got used to the new environment. I recommend it to everyone.

I found this guesthouse online when I was looking for a place for our 6-month-old Vizsla for the few days we were abroad.
I chose it based on the photos and reviews. I was very worried about our dog, because he had never been away from us before. But it was a shame to worry, because he clearly enjoyed being there.
The environment is beautiful, the kennels are spacious.
It was also clear that the owner knows dogs well, he treated our little, extravagant Vizsla very well from the first second, which is sometimes not so easy. 😄
Thank you for everything! We will definitely be back!

I was looking for a suitable place for my dog ​​for a week due to a trip abroad. A friend recommended the place. We were not disappointed - spacious kennels, nice clean environment, the dogs are not confined - everything was perfect for my dog. We would like to thank you again for the care and the suitable place. I would trust the owners with my dog ​​again with a calm heart, as it was obvious that he felt good.
While I was on vacation, my dog ​​was able to wait for me home in 5* conditions! I can only recommend it! Everything went smoothly🐶 …
The owner is very kind. It's obvious that he understands the language of pets. I would definitely recommend him to others. Thank you for everything.

We brought our cat and dog to the guesthouse. We were very satisfied with the environment and the owners.
The beds are spacious and kept clean. …

A big thank you to Ági and her husband for taking good care of my kitten for almost two weeks and for not having to worry about her safety for a moment.
She got a nice, clean, cool, cat-friendly room - at a friendly price.
We will definitely be back :)

I can only speak of it in superlatives. We are very happy that we found this guesthouse where our dog Málna stayed for the second time and she clearly had a great time! Beautiful surroundings, kind owner, I can only recommend it to everyone who wants to keep their pet safe and well-cared for. I wouldn't trust anyone else!🥰 …
Our timid kitty came home from a week of boarding very calm and balanced. I can only recommend it!
